obligations: outline.entry.indented is a public static identity and receiver method
a parent outline is required and is never fabricated or stored on the entry
fixed, boolean, functional zero-based, and automatic indentation preserve Content
automatic indentation uses measured prefix widths, per-level maxima, and the 1.2em fallback
gap contributes to hanging indentation and RTL uses the logical right inset
automatic prefix-info participates in contextual replay and fixpoint convergence
a present prefix is represented as a semantic PDF Label and exported as /Lbl
scope_out: positive execution through an outline.entry show rule
